entries.summary_local: Gornja Lastva je staro naselje na padinama Vrmca iznad Donje Lastve i Tivta, u Crnoj Gori.
entries.summary_en: Gornja Lastva is an old settlement on the slopes of Vrmac above Donja Lastva and Tivat, Montenegro.
entries.body_local:
Gornja Lastva je staro seosko naselje na obroncima brda Vrmac, iznad Donje Lastve i grada Tivta u Boki Kotorskoj. Selo ima crkvu Svete Marije iz 14. vijeka i, na visini od 440 metara, crkvu Svetog Vida iz 9. vijeka.

Prema popisu stanovništva iz 2011. godine, Gornja Lastva nije imala stalnih stanovnika. Uprkos tome, selo je živo mjesto okupljanja: svake prve subote u avgustu, od 1974. godine, održava se Lastovska fešta, a od 2015. godine i Dani pejzaža. Kulturni život odvija se u Domu kulture „Ilija Marković“.

Do 1945. godine u Gornjoj Lastvi radili su mlinovi za masline, što svjedoči o maslinarskoj tradiciji ovog kraja.

Koordinate (približne, prema hr.wikipedia): 42.4425 N, 18.6919 E.
entries.body_en:
Gornja Lastva is an old rural settlement on the slopes of the Vrmac hill, above Donja Lastva and the town of Tivat in the Bay of Kotor. The village has the church of St Mary from the 14th century and, at 440 metres above sea level, the church of St Vitus from the 9th century.

According to the 2011 census, Gornja Lastva had no resident population. Nevertheless the village is a living meeting place: every first Saturday of August since 1974 it hosts the Lastovska fešta (Lastva Festival), and since 2015 also the Dani pejzaža (Landscape Days). Cultural life takes place in the culture house Dom kulture "Ilija Marković".

Until 1945 olive mills operated in Gornja Lastva, a witness to the olive-growing tradition of the area.

Coordinates (approximate, per hr.wikipedia): 42.4425 N, 18.6919 E.

entries.title_en: Church of St Mary, Gornja Lastva
entries.summary_local: Crkva Svete Marije u Gornjoj Lastvi potiče iz 14. vijeka.
entries.summary_en: The church of St Mary in Gornja Lastva dates from the 14th century.
entries.body_local:
Crkva Svete Marije (Sv. Marija) je seoska crkva u Gornjoj Lastvi koja potiče iz 14. vijeka. Nalazi se u samom selu i središte je vjerskog i društvenog života zajednice, uključujući i Lastovsku feštu.

Koordinate su približne (lokacija sela).
entries.body_en:
The church of St Mary (Sv. Marija) is the village church of Gornja Lastva and dates from the 14th century. It stands in the village itself and is the centre of the community's religious and social life, including the Lastovska fešta.

Coordinates are approximate (village location).
entries.coords_source: approximate — village location per hr.wikipedia; to be surveyed

entries.summary_local: Crkva Svetog Vida iz 9. vijeka nalazi se na 440 metara nadmorske visine iznad Gornje Lastve.
entries.summary_en: The 9th-century church of St Vitus stands at 440 metres above sea level above Gornja Lastva.
entries.body_local:
Crkva Svetog Vida (Sv. Vid) je mala crkva iz 9. vijeka, jedna od najstarijih u ovom dijelu Boke. Nalazi se na visini od 440 metara nadmorske visine, na brdu iznad Gornje Lastve, i do nje vodi pješačka staza iz sela.

Koordinate su približne i biće zamijenjene snimljenim GPX tragom.
entries.body_en:
The church of St Vitus (Sv. Vid) is a small church from the 9th century, one of the oldest in this part of the Bay of Kotor. It stands at an altitude of 440 metres above sea level on the hill above Gornja Lastva and is reached by a footpath from the village.

Coordinates are approximate and will be replaced by a surveyed GPX track.
entries.coords_source: approximate — hill above Gornja Lastva; to be surveyed

entries.summary_local: Lastovska fešta se održava svake prve subote u avgustu od 1974. godine; 53. fešta je 7. avgusta 2027.
entries.summary_en: The Lastovska fešta is held every first Saturday of August since 1974; the 53rd festival is on 7 August 2027.
entries.body_local:
Lastovska fešta je tradicionalna ljetnja svečanost u Gornjoj Lastvi. Održava se svake prve subote u avgustu, neprekidno od 1974. godine. Fešta okuplja stanovnike Lastve, iseljenike i posjetioce uz muziku, ples i domaću hranu u selu.

53. Lastovska fešta biće održana u subotu, 7. avgusta 2027. godine.
entries.body_en:
The Lastovska fešta is the traditional summer festival of Gornja Lastva. It takes place every first Saturday of August, since 1974. The festival brings together the people of Lastva, the diaspora and visitors with music, dance and local food in the village.

The 53rd Lastovska fešta will be held on Saturday, 7 August 2027.
entries.recurrence_rule: first Saturday of August, annually since 1974

entries.summary_local: Dani pejzaža se u Gornjoj Lastvi održavaju od 2015. godine.
entries.summary_en: The Landscape Days (Dani pejzaža) have been held in Gornja Lastva since 2015.
entries.body_local: Dani pejzaža su manifestacija posvećena kulturnom pejzažu Vrmca i Gornje Lastve. Održavaju se od 2015. godine i okupljaju stručnjake, stanovnike i posjetioce oko tema zaštite i oživljavanja baštine i predjela.
entries.body_en: The Landscape Days (Dani pejzaža) are an event dedicated to the cultural landscape of Vrmac and Gornja Lastva. Held since 2015, they bring together experts, residents and visitors around the protection and revival of heritage and landscape.
entries.recurrence_rule: annually since 2015 (dates announced by the organisers)

entries.summary_local: Dom kulture „Ilija Marković“ je mjesto kulturnih događaja u Gornjoj Lastvi.
entries.summary_en: The culture house "Ilija Marković" is the venue of cultural events in Gornja Lastva.
entries.body_local: Dom kulture „Ilija Marković“ u Gornjoj Lastvi je prostor u kojem se održavaju izložbe, predavanja, radionice i skupovi zajednice, uključujući programe Dana pejzaža.
entries.body_en: The culture house "Ilija Marković" in Gornja Lastva is the space for exhibitions, lectures, workshops and community meetings, including programmes of the Landscape Days.

entries.title_local: Mlinovi za masline u Gornjoj Lastvi
entries.summary_local: U Gornjoj Lastvi su do 1945. godine radili mlinovi za masline.
entries.summary_en: Olive mills operated in Gornja Lastva until 1945.
entries.body_local: Maslinarstvo je bilo osnova života u Lastvi. U selu su do 1945. godine radili mlinovi za masline (toševi), u kojima su se masline mljele i cijedilo ulje. Ostaci mlinova i terasasti maslinjaci dio su kulturnog pejzaža Vrmca.
entries.body_en: Olive growing was the basis of life in Lastva. Olive mills operated in the village until 1945, where olives were crushed and the oil pressed. The remains of the mills and the terraced olive groves are part of the cultural landscape of Vrmac.

entries.summary_local: Po popisu iz 2011. godine Gornja Lastva nije imala stalnih stanovnika.
entries.summary_en: In the 2011 census Gornja Lastva had no resident population.
entries.body_local: Prema popisu stanovništva Crne Gore iz 2011. godine, u Gornjoj Lastvi nije zabilježen nijedan stalni stanovnik. Selo je ipak ostalo mjesto okupljanja zahvaljujući fešti, Danima pejzaža i radu zajednice.
entries.body_en: According to the 2011 census of Montenegro, no permanent resident was recorded in Gornja Lastva. The village nevertheless remained a meeting place thanks to the festival, the Landscape Days and the work of the community.

entries.summary_local: Donja Lastva je primorsko naselje ispod Gornje Lastve, na obali Tivatskog zaliva.
entries.summary_en: Donja Lastva is the coastal settlement below Gornja Lastva on the shore of the Bay of Tivat.
entries.body_local: Donja Lastva je naselje na obali Tivatskog zaliva, sjeverozapadno od centra Tivta. Iz Donje Lastve vodi pješačka staza uzbrdo do Gornje Lastve. Koordinate su približne.
entries.body_en: Donja Lastva is a settlement on the shore of the Bay of Tivat, north-west of the centre of Tivat. A footpath leads uphill from Donja Lastva to Gornja Lastva. Coordinates are approximate.

entries.summary_local: Tivat je grad i opština u Boki Kotorskoj; Gornja i Donja Lastva pripadaju opštini Tivat.
entries.summary_en: Tivat is a town and municipality in the Bay of Kotor; Gornja and Donja Lastva belong to the municipality of Tivat.
entries.body_local: Tivat je grad na obali Tivatskog zaliva u Boki Kotorskoj, Crna Gora. Sjedište je opštine kojoj pripadaju Gornja i Donja Lastva. Koordinate centra su približne.
entries.body_en: Tivat is a town on the Bay of Tivat in the Bay of Kotor, Montenegro. It is the seat of the municipality to which Gornja and Donja Lastva belong. Centre coordinates are approximate.
